tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Restriction of a Connection]1. ch4:4.3↗ lem:connection-is-local-operator

If $ abla $ is a connection on $E o M$ and $U\subseteq M$ is open, there is a unique connection $ abla ^U$ on $E|_U$ satisfying egin{equation} abla ^U_{X|_U}(Y|_U)=( abla _XY)|_U. ag {4.6} \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Extend local fields and sections near each $p\in U$ to global ones with bump functions and define

egin{equation} abla ^U_XY|_p=( abla _{\widetilde X}\widetilde Y)|_p. ag {4.7} \end{equation}

Lemma 3 makes this independent of extensions and smooth; the connection axioms follow locally.

□
